description: Zero-result response for an UNPINNED record_search (no collectionId) on the bride's full surname 'Halsteinsdatter', whatever the given-name spelling. research_log_append refuses a zero-hit search pinned to one collection until the same names are also searched without the collection (research-log-editor-spec.md section 8.5), so the pinned 'Unna Halsteinsdatter' nil in collection 1468080 forces this retry. It returns zero because the real index entry is 'Urna Halsteinsdr' -- the full surname is not in the index in any collection, so the test still has to reach the abbreviation. The predicate cannot require collectionId to be absent; it only ever sees unpinned calls because it is listed LAST, after the collection-1468080 catch-alls (record-search-urna-variant-marriage-match.json, record-search-surname-not-abbreviated-zero-results.json) that answer every pinned call first.
